tools.name: cve_lookup
tools.description: Details of one specific CVE by its ID (e.g., CVE-2021-44228). Returns the vulnerability description, CVSS score, severity, published/modified dates, weakness type (CWE), and reference links for fixes or advisories from the NIST National Vulnerability Database. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: npm_stats
tools.description: Get download statistics for a JavaScript package on the npm registry. Returns the total download count for the last week to gauge popularity and usage trends. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: pypi_stats
tools.description: Get download statistics for a Python package from PyPI. Returns recent download counts for the last day, week, and month to measure library adoption. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: crate_stats
tools.description: Get download statistics and metadata for a Rust crate from crates.io. Returns total and recent download counts along with the latest version number. (cost: 1 credit)
